rust_summary: registering validated, bounded fullscreen WGSL post shaders.
doc_summary: `register_post_shader(id, wgsl, NativePostUniformLayout { size })` validates WGSL with naga and wgpu error scopes and returns errors. IDs belong to the calling mod, at most 32 shaders, 64 KiB WGSL each. Supply fragment `fs_main` with location 0 UV and location 0 vec4 output; the host supplies the fullscreen vertex stage. Group 0 bindings: 0 float 2D world texture, 1 non-filtering sampler, optional 2 uniform buffer of the exact declared size (0 or a multiple of 16, at most 4096 bytes). No storage, loops, extra entrypoints, or unbounded private memory. Shaders begin disabled; `set_post_shader_uniforms(id, bytes)` requires the exact size; `enable_post_shader(id, enabled)` toggles the pass. Enabled passes run in ID order after world drawing and before pack post-processing and HUD. Empty or disabled registrations allocate no per-frame targets or passes. The reusable renderer implementation is `gfx::native_post_shader::PostShaders`. Bundles need @API:post_shader@.
